prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. The attached image is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY for original western game artwork. Generate an entirely new companion sprite atlas of EXACTLY FOUR NEW SYMBOLS. Do not reproduce its existing twelve-symbol layout. Match its mature richly painted aged brass, ivory bone, smoky steel, dark tobacco leather and oxblood enamel materials, subtle warm highlights and tactile engraved detail.
Asset type: production transparent sprite atlas, one HORIZONTAL ROW of four equally sized separated icons, preferably canvas about 4:1, 2048x512. Four imaginary square cells. Center each complete icon in its cell with generous empty transparent gutters. Each icon occupies 65–70% of its cell maximum dimension. No overlap or clipped edges.
Exact left-to-right order:
1. An ivory cattle skull with curved dark-tipped horns, subtle bone cracks and small gold nose-ring, front view, strong wide natural silhouette. This is an ordinary symbol, NO medallion or coin or border behind it, distinguish it strongly from a golden skull coin.
2. A bold antique brass railroad locomotive badge, three-quarter front view of a beautiful old steam locomotive, wheel and smokestack, round engraved golden medallion behind, small dark blank plaque at bottom reserved for native bonus text. No smoke going outside this cell.
3. A distinctive oxblood-and-antique-brass crossed revolvers bonus badge, two clearly separated ivory-handled revolvers crossed behind a deep oxblood enamel shield, tiny star at top, small blank dark plaque at bottom. Predominantly rich red so distinguishable from other badges.
4. A dark charcoal-and-gold skull-and-playing-cards bonus badge: carved ivory HUMAN skull over three fanned ivory playing cards, central black spade motifs only, within an ornate dark steel and warm gold crest, small blank dark plaque below. Predominantly charcoal/ivory/gold, NO red.
Constraints: hand-painted 2.5D volumetric realism, crisp legibility at small size, beautiful coherent original materials. No lettering, words, numerals, logos, watermark, gridlines, background, floor, checkerboard, or UI. Real transparent alpha background including all gutters. No connecting decorative lines. No huge glow halos. All four complete icons are isolated; their opaque forms antialiased naturally. Design artwork only, no copied commercial provider assets.
